verdict.rationale: Florida DOR documents a sanctioned agent rail for reemployment tax. Agents enroll clients through the e-File and e-Pay Enrollment System, or by batch enrollment for 100 or more clients, and agents and employee leasing companies can file returns electronically for employers. Missing for 10: documentation of how a company formally authorizes or revokes an agent (e.g., a power-of-attorney or consent step), permission-scoping details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: Agents must add, delete, or update client information electronically using one of the following methods: Use the e-File and e-Pay Enrollment System
If an agent has 100 or more clients to add or delete, the agent may use a batch enrollment file.
The Department provides employers, agents, and employee leasing companies an application that allows a user to file their reemployment tax return electronically.
